row_unit: one de-identified evidence item at one patient visit

future_experiments.longitudinal: previous plus current MRI to outcome
future_experiments.multimodal_longitudinal: previous/current MRI plus time-aligned clinical evidence to outcome
future_experiments.full_colvera: serial MRI plus endoscopy plus clinical trajectory plus comparable historical trajectories to local-regrowth outcome

safety_rules: Patient IDs must be de-identified study keys; no direct identifiers or PHI.
Each patient belongs to exactly one split.
Resource references must be relative to an approved data root; do not commit clinical images.
Outcome/event values and dates are prohibited from model feature selection.
All preprocessing, selection, calibration, abstention and retrieval choices are locked using development patients only before final test evaluation.
